verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a local model-serving runtime, so controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents nothing about context size settings, per-instance memory limits, or concurrent-instance memory management. GPU auto-detection and distributed worker nodes are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
